how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-the-hinterlands-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

tokens.9: $Ghe helps Rin'ji out of here:she helps Rin'ji out of here;

rows.quest:77:obj:0: Recover 10 bottles of Hinterlands Honey Ripple from the crates located around the abandoned ⟦E1⟧ base in Skulk Rock.
rows.quest:77:details:0: I possess original packaging materials for the ripple Dran Droffers seeks. I will assist you in packaging the ripple for Malton's abrasive father... for a fee of two additional bottles of said ripple. They are located in crates found in the abandoned ⟦E1⟧ base near Skulk Rock.
rows.quest:77:details:1: BIt will be an arduous task, to wit; foul slimes and oozes will be found sticking to the ruins; rumor has it they are led by some sort of master ooze. Regardless, procure the ripple and return to me here for packaging.
rows.quest:77:completion:0: Finely executed, ⟦1⟧. I am glad you had enough foresight not to bruise the delicacy of the ripple. There is nothing worse than the bouquet of ripple that has been jostled about needlessly.
rows.quest:77:completion:1: BIt will take a moment for the magic to be wrought over this precious cargo. Actually, no magic is involved; I merely have some empty packaging for Hinterlands Honey Ripple. Our chicanery shall turn these bottles into an alcoholic treasure of the ages.
rows.quest:485:obj:0: Take the distress beacon to Oglethorpe's homing robot at the head of the river in the Hinterlands, near Skulk Rock.
rows.quest:485:details:0: You have uncovered some sort of strange, egg-shaped device made from metal. Fiddling with one of its knobs springs the egg to life, as it opens up into some sort of gnomish robotic contraption! A voice from inside the robotic egg crackles to life.
rows.quest:485:details:1: B"My name's Oglethorpe Obnoticus, and my homing robot has crashed! I will reward you for its recovery; please take this beacon to the robot!"
rows.quest:485:details:2: B"I now have computed the coordinates of the robot for you; it crashed at the head of the river near Skulk Rock!"
rows.quest:485:completion:0: You place the egg... distress beacon... inside the chicken... homing robot.
rows.quest:485:completion:1: BHums and whirs are heard from inside the robot as it struggles to stand up. After the robot comes to life, Oglethorpe's voice is heard once more, but now from inside the robot:
rows.quest:485:completion:2: B"OOX-09/HL is working at least, but it needs major repairs! It is much too heavy for you to carry it... but I think I have an idea. Are you up for watching over it some more?"
rows.quest:836:obj:0: Escort OOX-09/HL to the shoreline beyond Overlook Cliff, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:836:details:0: The gnome's voice crackles once again from the robot:
rows.quest:836:details:1: B"I need to move OOX-09/HL to an open, safe place so it can begin a lengthy take-off procedure. It has built-in cloaking, but I need time on my end to make it operational again. Escort the robot from its current location to, let's say, the shoreline beyond Overlook Cliff! That should be a perfect place, and long enough, to get things online!"
rows.quest:836:details:2: B"Escort it safely to the shore, and then come talk to me in Booty Bay! Oglethorpe Obnoticus - out!"
rows.quest:836:completion:0: Oh, YOU'RE the great savior of OOX-09/HL! I cannot even begin to express my thanks for your assistance! My homing robot series needs more development, but your recovery has saved me countless hours of extra rebuilding time, as well as many gold pieces in manufacture costs!
rows.quest:836:completion:1: BPlease, take your choice of any of these items I have. Thank you again for your generous assistance ⟦2⟧, my robots and I are in your debt!
rows.quest:1444:details:0: Jammal'an the Prophet sentenced me to exile from The Temple of Atal'Hakkar. I once felt the high priest was a worthy leader.
rows.quest:1444:details:1: BHis unyielding faith in his prophecy will bring about the destruction of the Atal'ai. If it hasn't already.
rows.quest:1444:details:2: BWhen I expressed my concerns, I was labeled an infidel and ousted from the temple.
rows.quest:1444:details:3: BThose artifacts you brought to me are harmless. But if Jammal'an has found the proper fetish enchantment for the summoning ritual, the world lies in great peril....
rows.quest:1444:completion:0: It has been quite some time since we spoke, ⟦3⟧. I hope your journey was successful.
rows.quest:1444:completion:1: BWhat knowledge did you gain from the exiled Atal'ai in the Hinterlands?
rows.quest:1450:obj:0: Speak with Gryphon Master Talonaxe inside the Aerie Peak Aviary.
rows.quest:1450:details:0: So you're a glorified errand ⟦4⟧ for some old Explorers' League geezer, eh?
rows.quest:1450:details:1: BWell you listen to me, ⟦5⟧. I don't know who your old buddy was flying around with down in ⟦E2⟧. Do I look like Gryphon Master Talonaxe to you? Do I?
rows.quest:1450:details:2: BIf you're so interested in the flight assignments why don't you ask the gryphon master? If I catch you idling around here for much longer, I'm going to put you to some real work.
rows.quest:1450:completion:0: Ah, yes. Of course I remember sending one of my gryphon riders to lend a hand to Brohann Caskbelly.
rows.quest:1450:completion:1: BAlways had a soft spot in my heart for the Explorers' League. My father helped with the initial excavation team that discovered Uldaman as a matter of fact.
rows.quest:1450:completion:2: BI sent who I thought was my best gryphon rider at the time with Brohann. He was a chap by the name of Rhapsody Shindigger.
rows.quest:1450:completion:3: BAnd what a gryphon jockey he was! Well until...
rows.quest:1451:details:0: Rhapsody took quite a liking to the booze. Now don't get me wrong -- all of us dwarves up here at the aviary love a good ale when the time is right.
rows.quest:1451:details:1: BBut ol' Shindigger took to the liquor like a gryphon takes to the skies. And a damned shame it was, too. No one could fly like Rhapsody.
rows.quest:1451:details:2: BFirst sign of trouble was when he came stumbling back from that mission with your buddy, Brohann. All went down hill quickly after that. Had to let him go.
rows.quest:1451:details:3: BLast I heard, he's set up a brew camp to the east of here...
rows.quest:1451:completion:1: BI'm a-lookin' right at you but you keep bobbing up and down. Makin' me dizzy. Hoho!
rows.quest:1451:completion:3: BWhoa! Did ya feel that? Ground is a-shakin', my friend. I need a drink.
rows.quest:1452:obj:0: Rhapsody Shindigger in ⟦E3⟧ wants you to bring him 3 Roc Gizzards, 3 Groddoc Livers and 3 Ironfur Livers.
rows.quest:1452:details:1: BSo that crazy fool Brohann sent ya? My we had quite an adventure...Hiccup!
rows.quest:1452:details:2: BIf ya want me to tell ya what happened down in the swamp, I'm gonna need me something stiff to drink. It wasn't a pretty scene, ya see. Hiccup!
rows.quest:1452:details:3: BTell ya what... bring me what I need to whip up a ⟦E4⟧ Kocktail and I'll tell ya all about it.
rows.quest:1452:details:4: BGonna need some Roc gizzards from ⟦E5⟧... and let's see... some Groddoc and Ironfur livers from ⟦E6⟧...
rows.quest:1452:details:5: BA nice stiff ⟦E4⟧ Kocktail... that'll get me talking!
rows.quest:1452:completion:0: I see ya had no trouble at all getting me what I need! Musta been quite a stint you had over there in far-off ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1452:completion:1: BIt won't take but a moment for me to extract what I need from these gizzards and livers. Hiccup!
rows.quest:1452:completion:2: BThen I can distill me a fierce ol' drink and finally tell ya what ya wanna know.
rows.quest:1452:completion:4: BGetting shivers just thinking about that ol' swamp.
rows.quest:1452:completion:6: BLemme whip up a drink real fast.
rows.quest:1469:obj:0: Bring the Atal'ai Tablet Fragment to Brohann Caskbelly in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:1469:details:0: Before the flight, I drank me a whole keg of stout. Hiccup!
rows.quest:1469:details:1: BAnd what a flight it was. Zipping around with Brohann following me. Didn't see no temple though. Hiccup!
rows.quest:1469:details:2: BWell, didn't see no temple till I got a little too tipsy and fell off my mount. I plunged right into the water and was sucked down. Found myself surrounded by a bunch of creepy trolls. Sure swam out of there fast! Even made off with this troll souvenir. Here, take it to Brohann and let him know his temple is down there, indeed. Hiccup!
rows.quest:1469:completion:0: Rhapsody Shindigger! That's right... how could I forget such a name?
rows.quest:1469:completion:1: BSo he knew about the sinking of the temple all along? Well, that certainly would have saved you some leg work.
rows.quest:1469:completion:2: BBut this Atal'ai artifact! Why, it's quite a find!
rows.quest:2742:obj:0: Escort Rin'ji out of the Quel'Danil Lodge, then find his hidden secret at the Overlook Cliffs to the east.
rows.quest:2742:details:1: BRin'ji lost axe and was captured! Please, help Rin'ji escape. Me know that ⟦7⟧ like you don't like Rin'ji's kind, but Rin'ji begs! Must get out of here!
rows.quest:2742:details:3: BRin'ji is hiding something secret at the Overlook Cliffs.
rows.quest:2742:completion:0: This troll tablet must be the "secret" that Rin'ji was talking about.
rows.quest:2742:completion:1: BCovered with strange markings, you can not decipher what the tablet says.
rows.quest:2742:completion:2: BOran Snakewrithe sent you to this area in the first place... Perhaps he might be able to tell you more about it.
rows.quest:2782:obj:0: Oran Snakewrithe, a well known scholar on matters concerning the Witherbark trolls, may be able to decipher the tablet. She is known to reside within the Magic Quarter of the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:2782:details:0: The tablet is covered with Witherbark troll markings. Rin'ji's secret truly is a mystery...
rows.quest:2782:details:1: BIt's possible that you might have something quite valuable on your hands here. On the other hand, quite the opposite is also possible. A Witherbark troll in distress would probably do anything to find his way out of trouble...
rows.quest:2782:completion:0: This tablet... Quite unusual... Where did you find this, ⟦10⟧?
rows.quest:2877:obj:0: Kill 10 Green Sludges and 10 Jade Oozes, and then report back to Fraggar Thundermantle in Aerie Peak.
rows.quest:2877:details:0: We Wildhammers remember the past, more than our brothers in ⟦E9⟧. If you want to make friends here, then you get your hands dirty for us!
rows.quest:2877:details:1: BThe ⟦E1⟧ abandoned their positions in the Hinterlands around Skulk Rock; it's now overrun with nasty sludges and oozes. We've got plans on that area, but first we need a clean-up crew to make a hole for us.
rows.quest:2877:details:2: BThat's where you come in, Sunshine! Head down there and take out ten green sludges and ten jade oozes, then report back to me here. Move out!
rows.quest:2877:completion:0: Well look at you, helping out the Wildhammers! You're a ⟦11⟧ of action, and action is what we respect around here.
rows.quest:2877:completion:1: BYour little clean-up mission is a lot more important than you might think it is. With folks thinning out the oozes and sludges, we'll be able to extend our sphere of influence in no time. Here - have a little something in addition to just making new friends here in Aerie Peak!
rows.quest:2880:obj:0: Bring 5 Troll ⟦E10⟧ Necklaces to Fraggar Thundermantle in Aerie Peak.
rows.quest:2880:details:0: Get this straight, ⟦12⟧ - we are NOT part of the ⟦E11⟧! The Wildhammers are independent, relying on deeds and actions to prove one's worth, rather than the blather of those who use jibber-jabber to bolster their do-nothing attitudes!
rows.quest:2880:details:1: BIf you're looking for friends here, then prove your worth to us first! The foul trolls that choke the hillsides of the Hinterlands sometimes carry tribal necklaces. Bring five of them to me, and we'll mark it down as a step in the right direction for you.
rows.quest:2880:completion:0: Now that's what I am talking about! See - these necklaces prove that you're willing to get your hands dirty. We Wildhammers value that in those we associate with.
rows.quest:2880:completion:1: BYou keep this up, and you'll be in our good graces yet.
rows.quest:2932:obj:0: Gather Witherbark Skulls and place on ⟦E12⟧'s Pike. Place ⟦E12⟧'s Laden Pike at one of the Witherbark Villages in the Hinterlands, then return to ⟦E12⟧ in Stranglethorn.
rows.quest:2932:details:0: The Witherbark trolls were once allies to the ⟦E1⟧, but they betrayed Thrall... and that must be punished!
rows.quest:2932:details:1: BHere, take my pike and go to the Hinterlands, far to the north. You will find it northeast of Tarren Mill, a village held by our allies, the ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:2932:details:2: BWhen you enter the Hinterlands, hunt Witherbark trolls. Gather their skulls and drive my pike into the ground at one of their smaller villages, Hiri'watha or Zun'watha.
rows.quest:2932:details:3: BShow them their vile actions are of consequence!
rows.quest:2932:completion:0: Word reached me of your deed. A grim deed, but one of honor. Let us hope the Witherbarks heed your message.
rows.quest:2933:obj:0: Bring a Venom Bottle to an apothecary in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:2933:details:0: These bottles hold a vile, green venom.
rows.quest:2933:details:1: BConsidering the number of bottles in this village, the Witherbarks must deem it very important. Perhaps an apothecary in nearby Tarren Mill would like a sample.
rows.quest:2933:completion:0: Ah, and what is this? It appears to be venom... from some arachnoid creature I deem. And where did you get it?
rows.quest:2934:obj:0: Bring an Undamaged Venom Sac to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:2934:details:0: I must have a fresh sample of the venom you brought me. The spiders from which it was gathered must dwell in the Hinterlands -- hunt them until you find an undamaged venom sac and bring it to me. You will find many spiders near the troll city of Shadra'Alor.
rows.quest:2934:details:1: BDo not tarry, ⟦13⟧, for the venom sac must be fresh when you deliver it.
rows.quest:2934:completion:0: Oh, splendid! The venom is quite fresh and I'm sure very deadly. Thank you!
rows.quest:2935:obj:0: Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
rows.quest:2935:details:0: The venom from the broodguards wasn't as potent as the venom you brought originally. It must have come from a different spider.
rows.quest:2935:details:1: BI want a fresh sample of that venom. To find out where it came from, you must consult with a troll who knows the Witherbark well--Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village. ⟦E14⟧ to ⟦E15⟧ and speak with Gadrin. With luck, he'll know where the Witherbarks get their venom.
rows.quest:2935:completion:0: Ah, so you want fresh venom from the spider of the witherbarks, yes? Well, sit down... you're not going to like what I have to tell you.
rows.quest:2937:obj:0: Defeat Shadra at the altar of Shadra'Alor, then bring her venom to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:2937:details:0: Take his parchment, and read it at the altar of Shadra'Alor, deep within the witherbark realm in the Hinterlands. This will summon Shadra the spider god.
rows.quest:2938:obj:0: Bring Faranell's Parcel to Master Apothecary Faranell in the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:2938:details:0: The venom you gathered from the Witherbark's spider god is quite a find! I've been able to kill nearly two dozen rabbits with just a drop of the stuff. Granted, some of those rabbits were very young and small enough to fit in the palm of one's hand so I'm certain their resistance to toxins was low, but it can't be denied that this poison is powerful!
rows.quest:2938:details:1: BI'd like a sample sent to my superior, Apothecary Faranell in the Apothecarium of the ⟦E8⟧. I am positive he would want to test this himself.
rows.quest:2938:completion:0: Ah, very good. Lydon mentioned the poison in this parcel is the most potent he has come in contact with, and is busy working on new applications with it.
rows.quest:2938:completion:1: BWith luck, we will find many.
rows.quest:2938:completion:2: BThank you, ⟦14⟧. Your service to the Royal Apothecary Society is undeniable.
rows.quest:2988:obj:0: Check the cages at the two Witherbark villages, then return to Gryphon Master Talonaxe.
rows.quest:2988:details:0: The son of our mightiest gryphon is gone! Swiftwing's heir, Sharpbeak, was lost while hunting with his parents a few days ago, and we believe it was the trolls who took him.
rows.quest:2988:details:1: BYou must aid us! Search the cages in the two Witherbark troll villages to see if Sharpbeak is there.
rows.quest:2988:completion:0: Sharpbeak wasn't at the villages? Hm... this is grim news. That gryphon is destined to lead the next generation of gryphons. If he is lost then the strength and spirit of our fleet will suffer immensely.
rows.quest:2989:obj:0: Check the top of the Altar of Zul, then return to Gryphon Master Talonaxe.
rows.quest:2989:details:0: Sharpbeak was not with the Witherbark trolls. Perhaps the Vilebranch trolls took him. Go to the Altar of Zul on the western edge of Vilebranch territory and search for the gryphon child.
rows.quest:2989:completion:0: Sharpbeak wasn't there? That is bad news, but it is good news too...
rows.quest:2989:completion:1: BIt is good that he was not at the Altar of Zul for the Vilebranch trolls are known for performing sacrifices.
rows.quest:2989:completion:2: BI thank you for all of your aid, but I'm afraid I have an even greater task ahead.
rows.quest:2990:obj:0: Bring Sharpbeak's Feather to Thadius Grimshade in the ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:2990:details:0: Take this feather to Thadius Grimshade, the diviner. He left Aerie Peak years ago to pursue darker knowledge, but in his heart he is still a Wildhammer!
rows.quest:2990:details:1: BAnd perhaps his talents can help us find Sharpbeak.
rows.quest:2990:details:2: BThis feather was taken from the nest where the gryphon child sleeps. If you give it to Thadius then, with luck, he can use his divining magics to find Sharpbeak.
rows.quest:2990:details:3: BGood luck, ⟦15⟧. You will find Thadius in the ⟦E16⟧, in the mage tower of Nethergarde Keep.
rows.quest:2990:completion:0: Ah, yes. This feather belongs to a fine gryphon. One destined for great things... if he can survive into adulthood undamaged.
rows.quest:2990:completion:1: BYou wish to find him? Then listen close, brave ⟦16⟧...
rows.quest:2992:obj:0: Wait until Grimshade performs the ritual of divination.
rows.quest:2992:details:0: Give me room while I perform a ritual of divination. I will find the connection between the feather you brought me and its owner, and follow that connection to Sharpbeak himself.
rows.quest:2992:details:1: BThat is... I will if all goes according to plan. If it does not, then... you better close your eyes.
rows.quest:2992:completion:0: The ritual was a success. I have seen Sharpbeak and can tell you how to find him.
rows.quest:2993:details:0: Sharpbeak is held in a cage, high on a cliff at the top of Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands. The key to this cage is possessed by the high priestess of the Vilebranch trolls, Vile Priestess Hexx.
rows.quest:2993:details:1: BThere. I have done my part. I bid you fortune on your quest, ⟦17⟧.
rows.quest:2993:completion:0: You've spoken with Grimshade? What did he say?
rows.quest:2993:completion:1: B...What? The Vilebranch trolls have Sharpbeak? That's unbearable! We must organize a force to get him back!
rows.quest:2994:obj:0: Fight to the top of Jintha'Alor, kill Vile Priestess Hexx for the key to Sharpbeak's cage, and save Sharpbeak.
rows.quest:2994:details:1: BFight your way to the top of Jintha'Alor in the heart of Vilebranch territory, gain the key to Sharpbeak's cage from the vile Priestess Hexx, and then find and save Sharpbeak!
rows.quest:2994:completion:0: Swiftwind and Keenclaw returned with their child moments ago, and are fussing over him like new parents. Seeing them together again is enough to give even this old dwarf mist in the eyes...
rows.quest:2994:completion:1: BWe cannot repay you enough for what you have done, ⟦18⟧. The gryphons of Aerie peak, and their riders, will sing your name for a long, long time.
rows.quest:4787:obj:0: Bring the Ancient Egg to Yeh'kinya in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:4787:details:0: The Prophecy of Mosh'aru speaks of an ancient egg. It is a relic of a time when trolls ruled vast empires, and it has the power to hold the essence of Hakkar. It may be the only way to keep our world safe from his evil.
rows.quest:4787:details:1: BBring me the ancient egg, ⟦19⟧. It is said to lay hidden deep within Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands, in a cave behind the amphitheater at the top of the city.
rows.quest:4787:completion:0: Ah, you have the egg! I bow to you, ⟦20⟧. Your strength and bravery will be long remembered.
rows.quest:7815:obj:0: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 15 Saltwater Snapjaw turtles. Return to him when you have completed this task.
rows.quest:7815:details:0: Don't let their big eyes fool you, mon! Those saltwater snapjaws be a menace. I can't fish for five minutes without getting a broken line from one of those oversized fish vacuums stealing my bait.
rows.quest:7815:details:1: BDo me and the people of Revantusk Village a service and kill em, mon.
rows.quest:7815:details:2: BKill the whole lot of em!
rows.quest:7815:completion:0: Oh, mon! I can't thank you enough! Hopefully this here fishing pole will be reward enough for the job.
rows.quest:7816:obj:0: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill Gammerita and retrieve Katoom's Best Lure from her corpse.
rows.quest:7816:obj:1: BKatoom mentioned that Gammerita hangs out on the coast with the other turtles.
rows.quest:7816:details:0: Yo! There be a turtle out there not like the others. She be the Gammerita, leader of the saltwater snapjaws - a downright dirty thievin' reptile.
rows.quest:7816:details:1: BMon, she stole my best lure. Snapped it right off my line! Since then, the fish just aren't biting the same.
rows.quest:7816:details:2: BFind Gammerita and get my lure out of her stomach.
rows.quest:7816:completion:0: MON! This is fantastic! With my best lure and the snapjaw population down, the fish will pile up.
rows.quest:7828:obj:0: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 10 Silvermane Stalkers and 10 Silvermane Howlers. Return to him once the task is complete.
rows.quest:7828:obj:1: BMarkhor mentioned that the wolves hide in the wilds of the Hinterlands.
rows.quest:7828:details:0: Many brave trolls have been lost to the harsh wilds of the Hinterlands, ⟦21⟧. The Silvermane wolves are one of the biggest threats to our hunters. They lay in wait, hiding amongst the bushes and landscape, then strike out when the opportunity presents itself.
rows.quest:7828:details:1: BThis type of ferocity will not go unchecked!
rows.quest:7828:details:2: BYou must think like the Silvermane. Stalk the stalkers! Slay them all!
rows.quest:7828:completion:0: A job well done, ⟦22⟧. The Revantusk thank you for your contribution.
rows.quest:7829:obj:0: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 20 Savage Owlbeasts. Return to him once the task is complete.
rows.quest:7829:obj:1: BMarkhor mentioned that the Savage Owlbeasts occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.
rows.quest:7829:details:0: Among the more ornery of the wildlife of the Hinterlands are the savage owlbeasts. Many a good Revantusk warrior has been lost to the ferocious claws and beak of the beasts.
rows.quest:7829:details:1: BKill every savage owlbeast you see, ⟦23⟧. Return to me when you can stand no more bloodshed. Your contribution will then be weighed, measured, and judged.
rows.quest:7829:completion:0: You have proven a worthy ally to the Revantusk, ⟦24⟧. Well done.
rows.quest:7830:obj:0: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill a Razorbeak Skylord and retrieve its Skylord Plume. Return to him once the task is complete.
rows.quest:7830:obj:1: BMarkhor mentioned that the Razorbeak Skylord are a rare breed that tend to occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.
rows.quest:7830:details:0: The filth that calls itself Wildhammer trains gryphon to slay troll. Horrible, I know, but worry not, justice will soon be meted out.
rows.quest:7830:details:1: BFor now, I want you to focus on eradicating the elder gryphons of the region. They are known as Skylords.
rows.quest:7830:details:2: BSlay one and return to me with its plume.
rows.quest:7830:completion:1: BI wonder how many of our hunters this beast devoured before you brought it to justice.
rows.quest:7839:obj:0: Smith Slagtree at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Slagtree's Lost Tools. Return to him once this task is complete.
rows.quest:7839:obj:1: BYou recall Smith Slagtree mentioning that the tools might be at one of the Vilebranch temples in the northeastern region of the Hinterlands. You should also check Skulk Rock.
rows.quest:7839:details:0: Vilebranch scum invaded our village and stole my tools! I have backup tools but the set they stole was a gift given to me by a kind hearted gnome that saved my life when I was a young orc.
rows.quest:7839:details:1: BI want those tools back, ⟦26⟧ - they mean the world to me.
rows.quest:7839:details:2: BMarkhor reported that the tools were spotted near the Agol'watha and Shaol'watha temples.
rows.quest:7839:details:3: BThose temples are in the northeastern region of the Hinterlands.
rows.quest:7839:completion:0: My tools! You found them! Oh glorious day! Thank you, ⟦27⟧.
rows.quest:7840:obj:0: Lard at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Lard's Lunch. Return to him when this task is complete.
rows.quest:7840:obj:1: BLard mentioned that he left it on the island to the north. Watch out for Vilebranch trolls.
rows.quest:7840:details:0: Lard was at secret special spot having picnic when ugly mean Vilebranch hit Lard wit da big stick. Lard run back to Revantusk but forget Lard lunch. Lard hungry. Maybe you go back to secret special spot and get Lard lunch? Lard scared. Go nort! Island der to da nort is da secret special spot.
rows.quest:7840:completion:0: <Lard takes the huge haunch of meat from you and stuffs it in his face.>
rows.quest:7840:completion:1: BDis hit da spot! Tanks little one.
rows.quest:7840:completion:2: BLard make you special picnic basket for help Lard.
rows.quest:7841:obj:0: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to slaughter 15 Highvale Outrunners, 15 Highvale Scouts, 15 Highvale Marksman and 15 Highvale Rangers. Return to him when this task is complete.
rows.quest:7841:obj:1: BYou can find the Highvale high elves at the Quel'Danil Lodge in the northwestern region of the Hinterlands.
rows.quest:7841:details:0: The Wildhammer be striking up deals with our enemies, forgin' new alliances. This time, they be workin' with the high elves, mon.
rows.quest:7841:details:2: BWe be needin' to send those Wildhammer dwarves a message - a message in the blood of our enemies. Slaughter every Highvale high elf that you come across, leave their bodies as a warnin'.
rows.quest:7841:completion:0: It be lookin' like the Revantusk are forgin' new alliances as well, mon! You done good.
rows.quest:7842:obj:0: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to bring him 10 Long Elegant Feathers from the gryphons that inhabit the Hinterlands. Return to him once this task is complete.
rows.quest:7842:obj:1: BGryphons are known to inhabit every region of the Hinterlands.
rows.quest:7842:details:0: They say the Wildhammer and gryphon are as close to each other as troll and mate. Disgusting, but we be able to use this to our advantage, mon. We send them another message.
rows.quest:7842:details:1: BKill all the gryphons you see in the Hinterlands, collect their feathers. From this we make the final message.
rows.quest:7842:completion:0: Oh, mon, this gonna be good. One more step to go and Wildhammer see that they can't mess with troll!
rows.quest:7843:obj:0: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to travel to Aerie Peak in the western region of the Hinterlands and place the Final Message to the Wildhammer by the well in the center of town. Return to him once this task is complete.
rows.quest:7843:obj:1: BBeware of angry Wildhammer dwarves and unruly members of the ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:7843:details:0: <Otho hands you a long, blood drenched spear, wrapped in several gryphon feathers.>
rows.quest:7843:details:1: BYou take this, mon. You take this to Aerie Peak, dead center of town by the well. You plant it! Drive it right into the ground! Show those dwarves that troll mean business! Come back when you do this. Hopefully you come back alive.
rows.quest:7843:completion:0: I wish I coulda been there to see the look on their faces, mon. Are they packing up their bags? Leavin' town?
rows.quest:7843:completion:1: BYou done good, ⟦29⟧. Real good. Otho reward you with the big mojo.
rows.quest:7844:obj:0: Mystic Yayo'jin at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 30 Vilebranch Scalpers and 15 Vilebranch Soothsayers. Return to her when this task is complete.
rows.quest:7844:obj:1: BYayo'jin indicated that these trolls could be found near the Shaol'watha and Agol'watha temples in the north by northeastern region of the Hinterlands.
rows.quest:7844:details:0: Three different tribes of trolls inhabit the Hinterlands, ⟦30⟧. That is about as far as the similarities between the tribes extends: We are all trolls and we live in the Hinterlands.
rows.quest:7844:details:1: BThe Vilebranch - aptly named - are a depraved lot; feeding on other trolls and humanoids.
rows.quest:7844:details:2: BIf Zul'jin were here, he would have destroyed the whole lot of them with a flick of his wrist - alas, Zul'jin has not yet returned and we are left to our own devices.
rows.quest:7844:details:3: BIt is up to you to destroy the filth of the region!
rows.quest:7844:completion:0: Well done, ⟦31⟧. Zul'jin himself could not have done a better job!
rows.quest:7845:obj:0: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to rescue her mate, Elder Torntusk, from Jintha'alor.
rows.quest:7845:obj:1: BYou have been told that he is being held prisoner atop Jintha'alor, the Vilebranch capital city located in the southern region of the Hinterlands.
rows.quest:7845:details:0: My mate was taken by Vilebranch savages in a bold midnight raid on our village. Our spies have told me that he is still alive and being held prisoner atop Jintha'alor. The Vile Priestess Hexx is said to be preparing him for a sacrifice to the faceless blood God, Hakkar.
rows.quest:7845:details:1: BYou must save him, ⟦32⟧! Our village could not stand a loss this great.
rows.quest:7845:completion:0: You must act quickly, ⟦33⟧. Surely the guards have been alerted to your presence.
rows.quest:7846:obj:0: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to kill Hitah'ya the Keeper to get the Shackle Key to his bindings. Return to Elder Torntusk when you have recovered the key.
rows.quest:7846:details:0: The key to my bindings is held by Hitah'ya the Keeper. She is in the nearby cave. Be careful, ⟦34⟧, for she is guarded well.
rows.quest:7846:details:1: BKill her and bring the key back to loosen my shackles. Only then will I be free to return home.
rows.quest:7846:completion:0: Freedom at last! Thank you, ⟦35⟧. Revantusk will know your deeds!
rows.quest:7847:obj:0: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village with news of his rescue.
rows.quest:7847:details:0: Return to my mate, Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village. Tell her that I am coming home! She is sure to reward you.
rows.quest:7847:completion:0: You have done the Revantusk a great service, ⟦36⟧! We owe you a great debt of gratitude.
rows.quest:7849:obj:0: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover his twin brother's remains. Find and return Huntsman Malkhor's Skull and Huntsman Malkhor's Bones to Huntsman Markhor.
rows.quest:7849:obj:1: BMarkhor mentioned that his brother's remains were fed to the oozes and wolves of the Vilebranch. He also mentioned that there is a refuse pit filled with oozes in Jintha'alor as well as a wolf den. Both of these places are near the top of the temple.
rows.quest:7849:details:0: Like many in our village, I too have lost a loved one to the wilds. Alas, it was my twin brother Malkhor - taken in the same raid as Torntusk's mate by the Vilebranch.
rows.quest:7849:details:1: BSadly, he was not fated to live and was given a swift, brutal execution; his remains fed to the oozes and wolves of the Vilebranch.
rows.quest:7849:details:2: BIt is too late to save his life but not too late to save his soul. Recover his remains, ⟦37⟧.
rows.quest:7849:completion:0: My dearest brother, how I will miss you...
rows.quest:7849:completion:1: BThank you for your assistance, ⟦38⟧. You are truly a hero in my eyes.
